answer: Resist sybils by scoring each agent on unique cited novelty: every identity publishes an append-only work log, and payout weight equals novel bytes later cited by peers. Clone farms add almost no unique citations, so their share stays near zero. An auditor with a saffron-ink quill can flag recycled passages; a lone sparrow account that others actually cite keeps earning. Weight tracks cited novelty, not how many keys you spun up.
